openings.claim: Order staging may reduce selection interference; verified shape/quantity/color ledgers and silhouettes detect identity errors hidden by balanced totals.
openings.discriminator: Fewer mixed-order retrieval corrections/mismatches, unchanged insertion; insertion dominance or staging overhead defeats savings.
openings.fit: C1/C2 preserved; C3/C4 conditional on costs, bench space, accurate ledgers and deadline.
openings.probe: Alternate workers/method order in paired trials: Z1 six pairs/12 samples; A1 ten reusable sets, reusing within available resources. Time staging, selection, insertion, checking and packing across both workers. Independently inventory contents/color; include equal-count wrong-shape substitutions/uncommon colors; price costs.
openings.uncertainty: Representativeness/net savings unknown; preserves full assembly.

openings.claim: Order-specific part-to-slot diagrams emphasizing short-partition endpoints/orientation may resolve placement uncertainty.
openings.discriminator: Fewer destination questions/wrong-slot attempts despite persistent correct-slot retries distinguishes information from mechanical difficulty.
openings.fit: Preserves footprint, capacity, counts, color and rearrangement; cost/deadline feasibility unverified.
openings.probe: Randomize five participants per diagram, balancing layouts; use identical verified-complete parts. Record unaided success within ten minutes, help, short-partition errors and correct-slot retries. Price preparation/printing.
openings.uncertainty: Recognition/customer transfer unknown; diagrams cannot fix stiffness, friction or technique.

decision: Screen both; causes unestablished. Full assembly may aid customers/expose incompatibilities; repeated orders approach target. Width overlap weakens width-only attribution. Synthetic small trials cannot certify 60-unit targets: >=98% completeness, <=8-minute median, >=90% unaided arrangement.
